item.description:
We’re introducing Gemini 3.5 — our latest family of AI models combining frontier intelligence with action.
We’re starting the rollout with Gemini 3.5 Flash, our strongest agentic and coding model yet. Whether you're writing complex code or streamlining your daily workflow, we designed this model to help you get more done. It can tackle heavy-lifting tasks at four times the speed of comparable AI models — often at less than half the cost.
Because Gemini 3.5 Flash is now our default model, you'll experience this leap in speed and intelligence across the tools you already use, from the Gemini app to AI Mode in Search and across our developer platforms.
Learn more → goo.gle/4nFp9iY

item.title: Yesterday at #GoogleIO, we introduced Gemini Omni — our next step toward AI models that can create anything from any input. This means you can upload...
item.description:
Yesterday at #GoogleIO, we introduced Gemini Omni — our next step toward AI models that can create anything from any input.
This means you can upload any combination of text, audio, and images and Omni will reason across them to create a cohesive output.
With an intuitive understanding of physics and Gemini's knowledge of history, science and cultural context — the stories and outputs you create with Omni can respond logically to every action, just like in the real world.
Starting with video: you can mix and match photos, audio, and text to build something entirely new, or take a video you already shot and make edits just by asking. 🎥✨
Gemini Omni Flash is rolling out today to all Google AI Plus, Pro and Ultra subscribers globally through the Gemini app and Google Flow. It’s also rolling out at no cost to users on YouTube Shorts and YouTube Create App starting this week. In the coming weeks, we'll also be rolling it out to developers and enterprise customers via APIs.
Learn more → goo.gle/4tNXb62

item.title: At Google I/O 2026, we shared how we’re making AI more helpful for everyone. We’re releasing two new models, Gemini Omni and Gemini 3.5. Gemini Omni...
item.description:
At Google I/O 2026, we shared how we’re making AI more helpful for everyone.
We’re releasing two new models, Gemini Omni and Gemini 3.5. Gemini Omni can create anything from any input, starting with video, and is a leap forward in world understanding, multimodality and editing, while Gemini 3.5 Flash is the first in our latest family of models combining frontier intelligence with action.
We’re also unlocking agents and agentic experiences across our products — like with Information agents in Search, Gemini Spark and Daily Brief in the Gemini app and the launch of Universal Cart, a truly intelligent shopping cart.
Read to learn more about what’s new.

item.title: At Google I/O 2026, we shared the latest in how we’re making AI helpful for everyone: ✨ Gemini Spark is a 24/7 personal AI agent designed to proacti...
item.description:
At Google I/O 2026, we shared the latest in how we’re making AI helpful for everyone:
✨ Gemini Spark is a 24/7 personal AI agent designed to proactively manage tasks and help you navigate your digital life — all under your direction — in Gemini.
🧬 We debuted our latest advanced models, Gemini Omni, so you can create anything from any input — starting with video, and Gemini 3.5 Flash, which we’re making available today globally in the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search.
🧑💻 We’re expanding the Google Antigravity ecosystem to to enable developers to build and deploy agents.
🤝 And we launched new features — from Docs Live to Universal Cart — aimed at improving learning, knowledge, creativity and productivity for more people.
Learn more about our key announcements and let us know what you’re most excited for in the comments.
